prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, pre-upload inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress tip carousels and setup checklists, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, post-waiting auth reorders, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns significantly improved performance.
Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, instant path activation incentives, interactive sound and visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners, spotlight flows, or video cards hurt conversion.
No clear effect seen: Audio or background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators or overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-waiting auth stage reorders, and wait progress checklists or tip carousels performed better than expected.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, split-view story intros, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Setup Checklist Screen: Add a new screen called new_desktop_controls after home intro that guides users through hiding, showing, and interacting with their desktop companion. (why: Support received 3 separate complaints about users not knowing how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Style Verification & Live Preview Stage Flow: Introduce an extra verification screen new_photo_verify during adoption to let users inspect and adjust photo style options before generation starts. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures or incorrect companion visual rendering, and adoption mean time is high at 1017s.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Auth Stage Shift Flow: Reorder the sign_in screen to take place right after waiting completes so users generate their pet before authenticating. (why: 8 support emails mentioned losing pets upon sign-in reset; placing authentication after waiting protects generation progress.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Re-Login Pet Sync Safeguard Hint: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing into their original account restores saved companions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Readiness Progress & Tip Checklist: Display an active setup checklist and live tip carousel on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to abandonment or app stalls.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Compact Grid Path Selection Screen Layout: Change the choose_path screen layout to compact grid style to present preset and custom paths cleanly side-by-side. (why: The initial path decision has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis during path selection.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Companion Identity Badge: Add an official companion identity seal badge on the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet registration success. (why: Builds user commitment and visual confirmation before waiting for long background rendering.)
7: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Controls Assistance Headline Copy: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain desktop click and context menu controls. (why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to hide, open, or control their pet post-onboarding.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Render Completion System Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when companion generation finishes. (why: Waiting takes over 35 minutes on average, causing users to minimize the app and miss completion.)

scores.note: New screens and finish guidance flows consistently hurt conversion in historical tests.
Photo style verification and inspections performed better than expected despite new screen overhead.
Post-waiting auth reorders address explicit support complaints and were proven helpful and underpredicted.
Session reset safeguard hints significantly improved performance and directly address user complaints.
Wait progress tip carousels and setup checklists were strongly helpful and underpredicted.
Path selection layout improvements show consistent positive lift (+2.3% measured).
Adoption incentive badges showed no clear effect or slight negative impact in past iterations.
Finish stage copy changes and desktop finish guidance banners historically hurt performance.
Home notifications showed modest positive measured lift despite mixed background notification lessons.
